name: archboard-scene
responsibility: Holds the renderer core's drawing contract: the drawing a layout answers, the request a painter takes, and the typed scene every painter draws, with the reading of a picture's key
description: The contract crate of ADR 0091, 12 names; no crate re-exports a name of another. archboard-painting builds every scene, and the scene's types stay plain data. names.rs spells an enum's value by its name; sequence_picture.rs holds the sequence picture's types, reached through request.
